rr.p0480.b019: On a battlemat or large sheet of paper,
rr.p0480.b021: leader tallies the hits scored against his
rr.p0480.b023: army. The besieging army leader then
rr.p0480.b024: removes units from the assault zone
rr.p0480.b026: with a combined battle rating equal to or greater than the total hits scored against
rr.p0480.b027: his army. The defending army leader
removes units from the stronghold walls
